data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to access Meta AI glasses camera and microphone streams.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart API to register Meta AI glasses, request permissions, and stream live video (and optional audio) directly into a Flutter Texture. It also exposes raw frame data for further processing.
use_when: You need live video from Meta AI glasses in a Flutter app
You want raw camera frames for on‑device ML or computer‑vision
Background streaming of the glasses camera is required
avoid_when: Your app targets generic cameras or other wearables
You need a pure‑Dart solution without native platform code
strengths: Native‑to‑Flutter texture rendering eliminates extra decoding
Complete registration, permission, and session workflow
Provides raw RGBA/YUV/HEVC frames and optional microphone audio
Supports background streaming on iOS and Android
weaknesses: Works only with Meta wearables; no fallback for other devices
iOS background streaming may terminate unexpectedly
Requires native platform configuration and deep‑link handling
data.setup_notes: Add platform‑specific manifest entries, configure deep‑link handler, request Android permissions and iOS camera/microphone permissions, and follow the setup guide in the README.
